source_block.parva: Vana Parva · Kirātārjunīya (Arjuna’s penance · Shiva as kirata · Pāśupatāstra)
source_block.divergence: BORI CE / Debroy place Arjuna’s Himalayan penance, the boar, the kirata duel, Shiva’s reveal, and the gift of the Pāśupata in Vana (Kirātārjunīya arc). Ganguli’s vulgate English maps the same beats under Vana Parva Kirata / Arjuna-and-Mahadeva sections. Gita Press Gorakhpur tells the same Kirātārjunīya under its Vana numbering. Beats agree: penance → boar → honor dispute → duel → humility → Shiva reveal → Pāśupata gift.
source_block.chosen: Gita Press Gorakhpur + BORI overlap for the Kirātārjunīya itself. Debroy for BORI beat map. Ganguli for English duel/reveal wording.
source_block.notes: Not TV. Comic-mythology Shiva (luminous blessing, not horror). Never attach Ep01 plate-wide-gold or this episode’s plate-wide-gold as Imagine refs. Arjuna: Ep 09 face family; cream ascetic dhoti; no peacock; no gold breastplate.
